**Correction — console pin in the Environment line.**

This run's Environment line says vendored console pin `6314e87f`. That is the **repo-root `.objectui-sha`** (updated 2026-08-11 06:35) — the pin `main` wants. The bundle the server actually **served** during this run is `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` = **`09987b680d53801c79f67d969b14e9bb732b8a22`** (built 2026-08-10 09:58). Root and dist disagree because dist has not been rebuilt against the newer pin.

**No verdict changes.** Both console-lane observations here — the attachment panel rendering "No attachments yet" on a 403, and the inline grid's receipt cell — were made by driving the **running** bundle in a browser, so they describe what actually shipped in this run regardless of which sha is quoted.

Anyone reproducing the panel empty-state finding should check out **`09987b680`**.

## Extraction ledger — COMPLETE. Closing.

Every PARTIAL, the fixture item and the checklist-maintenance list extracted. This run had **0 FAIL** — the storage authz core is genuinely solid, and every card below is a surfacing, coverage or enforce-or-remove gap rather than a broken gate.

| Run item | Finding | Card | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `download-authz-both-sides` c4 (PARTIAL) | a **403** attachment list is rendered as "No attachments yet" + an Upload affordance the server would refuse — an operator cannot tell "nothing here" from "not yours" | objectstack-ai/objectui#4269 | objectui |
| `upload-session-abort` c4 (PARTIAL) | `failed` / `expired` `sys_upload_session.status` values have **no writer anywhere** — the retention `onlyWhen` references two states the system can never enter | #7667 | `domain:services` |
| `attach-requires-parent-edit` c3 (PARTIAL) | the #4757 unscoped-multi-delete pin **cannot execute** against the prebuilt `@objectstack/core` (17 cases error on `withoutOperationPrivateKeys`) | #7668 | `domain:devx` |
| `inline-grid-receipt-cells` c3 (PARTIAL) | clause text predates ADR-0104 — expects a resolved stored-file object; the shipped (correct) value is the opaque `sys_file` id | #7669 | `domain:devx` |
| Fixture | land the runtime-provisioned `qa_vault` / `qa_shared` / `qa_nofiles` + two real personas as a permanent fixture | #7670 | `domain:devx` |
| Checklist maintenance | `size` → `totalSize` step-text correction + the cross-reference index | #7671 | `domain:devx` |

The 4 PASS items produced no cards.

### #7668's stale-premise check changed its lane, and that matters

The obvious reading — "a core export is missing" — is **wrong**. `withoutOperationPrivateKeys` **is** exported on `origin/main` (`operation-private-keys.ts:115`, re-exported `index.ts:145`), so this is a **build-ordering / CI stale-dist** gap, not an engine defect: the pin resolves a `@objectstack/core` build that predates the source. Filed `domain:devx` accordingly (CI must rebuild core before running the pin, or the clause needs a live oracle). Had it been filed on the symptom it would have gone to `engine-core` and wasted a dispatch.

### Worth acting on beyond the cards

The area's declared `knownGap` ("no private files-enabled parent exists on stock showcase") **would have forced `blocked(fixture)` on the entire authz core**. The runner closed it by authoring scratch objects at runtime and provisioning two real sign-up personas, touching no repo file — which is why this run has real coverage instead of a wall of blocked clauses. #7670 exists so the next run does not have to repeat that.

Provenance: maintainer standing rule that every QA problem becomes an issue; run records close at extraction, same exit as #7514/#7463/#7627.
